title: Batch research bookkeeping landings: one PR per research-queue-dispatch run instead of results-batch + queue-receipt + queue-stamp (+ slo/grade) separately
note: Filed by CI-STREAMLINE (step 5 of the operator's 2026-11-03 directive). MEASURED: in the 24h to 2026-11-03 21:20Z, 58 research-bookkeeping PRs merged (results-batch, queue-stamp, queue-receipt, research-slo, research-result, grade, replenish, loss-receipt; 200 most recent closed PRs). ONE dispatcher run (41703356970) produced three: #22723 results-batch, #22725 queue-receipt, #22727 queue-stamp. Each PR pays 4 required jobs (checkout + install) whatever its size. BUILD: have research-queue-dispatch.yml write results, receipt and stamps on ONE automation branch per run and open ONE PR; research-slo/grade fold into the next dispatch PR when they land in the same window. Requires reading the producer workflows (.github/actions/research-result, research-queue-dispatch.yml land job) in full. Done-when: dispatcher-produced PRs per run = 1, measured over 24h of runs. Not built in CI-STREAMLINE because it touches the producers, not the checks. EXACT STEPS (CI-STREAMLINE lane, 2026-11-03 ~22:40Z). (1) research-queue-dispatch.yml land job: replace the three commit-to-main steps (results-batch L548, receipt L609, stamps L662) with ONE commit-to-main, branch-prefix automation/research-cycle, paths 'comms/research research/results research/queue' plus 'docs/claude/work/research-queue-dispatch-receipt.json' ONLY when the existing in-flight-receipt check finds no fresh (<90 min) receipt-bearing PR (extend its jq to match research-cycle too). Keep verify-merged true and close-on-fail true. Run the 'Assert every batched record is readable on main' step after it. The condition is collect_count!=0 OR FIRE==true OR receipt due. (2) scripts/research/dispatch_queue.py: STAMP_BRANCH_PREFIX -> a tuple ('automation/research-queue-stamp','automation/research-cycle'); pending_stamp_units uses startswith(tuple). (3) scripts/research/collect_runner_results.py: _BATCH_PREFIX likewise becomes a tuple, and the jq select in pending_in_open_batches ORs both prefixes. (4) tests: test_research_queue_dispatch_fire_gate.py (verified prefixes L186-201), tests/test_commit_to_main_callers.py DEFERRED_VERIFY (the receipt no longer defers), and a new test that one dispatcher run opens at most one PR. (5) RISK to test first: a close-on-fail of the combined PR drops that run's stamps, and pending_stamp_units no longer sees a CLOSED PR, so units fired this cycle can re-fire before their results land (today the same is true of the stamps PR alone). Mitigation: keep fired_run_units() (48 h run-name scan) in the fire gate; it already catches a fired run whose stamp never landed. Expected gain: 3 -> 1 PRs per dispatcher run, i.e. ~2 x 4 required jobs saved per run (about 360 research bookkeeping PRs/wk from the COMPUTE-ALLOCATION 7-day census: results-batch 134 + stamp 123 + receipt 104). Measured for context (comms/ci/human-pr-latency-decomposition-2026-11-04.json): automation PRs already merge at p50 13.4 min, so batching was not the merge-path lever.
